title: *LIFETIME FITNESS FOR HEALTH
description: Provides up-to-date and relevant health and wellness information; practical strategies to implement positive behavior change in physical activity, nutrition, and stress management throughout college and the lifespan.
clssnotes: To fulfill fitness requirement in the Bacc Core, the two-credit lecture must be taken as well as either a one-credit PAC course-OR-a one-credit HHS lab/activity. A previously taken PAC class will satisfy the lab/activity requirement. Visit website for more details: health.oregonstate.edu/HHS-231/special-exam
